status: frozen before any model was implemented or fitted on the dataset; freeze commit recorded in docs/empirical-evaluation.md
claim_status: replayed empirical result (replay metrics); empirical observation (direct properties of the measurements only); counterfactual predictions are reported as unvalidated model outputs

trajectories.test: uVal, yVal (1024 samples; the documentation's test record)

split.validation: estimation samples 769–1024 (hyperparameter and structure selection only)
split.final_fit: all 1024 estimation samples with the selected hyperparameters
split.test: the test record, evaluated once per final model; never used for fitting, selection or stopping

preprocessing: none beyond parsing; signals in volts as stored
normalization: feature-learning inputs/outputs standardized with estimation-record mean and standard deviation; all other models on raw volts

initialization.simulation_mode_input_output_models: the first L measured test outputs (L = the model's largest output lag) seed the recursion; those L samples are counted as model outputs equal to the measurements in the benchmark RMSE and excluded in the secondary RMSE
initialization.state_space_and_grey_box: initial states are free parameters estimated on the estimation record and reused for the test record, as licensed by the documentation (same unknown initial state for both records)

modes: one-step prediction (test input and past test outputs)

metrics.primary: e_RMSt (benchmark §4) on all 1024 test samples, per mode
metrics.regime: RMSE separately on test samples with measured y ≥ 9.0 V (upper band where the documentation's Figure 2 shows saturation) and y < 9.0 V; the band is used for evaluation only

models.structure: ARX y(t) = Σ a_i y(t−i) + Σ b_j u(t−nk−j+1) + c
second-order output-error model (equivalent to a 2-state linear state-space model) with offset
models.fit: simulation-error minimization, Nelder–Mead, 5 multi-starts (seeds 1–5), ≤ 4000 evaluations each
models.selection: best validation simulation RMSE among starts

models.structure: degree-2 polynomial in y(t−1..t−na), u(t−nk..t−nk−nb+1) with ridge 1e-6
equations (1)–(3) of the documentation, y = x2 + c; forward Euler with 4 sub-steps per sample; states clipped at 0
M4a plus saturation of x1 and x2 at fitted maxima (overflow documented in §2)
M4b as the digital model, synchronized to the sensor feed by an extended Kalman filter in prediction mode (state updates only; no parameter updates on test data)
models.noise_settings: process and measurement variances fitted on the estimation record

models.structure: NARX-MLP, inputs y(t−1..t−L), u(t..t−L+1), 8 tanh hidden units
models.training: full-batch Adam, 500 epochs, lr 0.01, seeds 1–5; one-step training; results reported per seed and as the mean

models.structure: two ARX(na, nb, nk) regimes switched by y(t−1) ≥ θ
models.hyperparameters: (na, nb, nk) as M1; θ ∈ {7, 8, 9} V

models.structure: records replayed through the v0.3.0 external adapter (provenance and uncertainty as configuration); v0.3.0 grammarMorphogenesis on {u, y} with selection restricted to the estimation fit rows (trainUntil); generated variables + {u(t), y(t)} → least-squares one-step readout; full mutation registry and meta-grammar, 3 rounds
models.modes: one-step prediction only — generated variables are functions of measured series and the adapter has no generative simulation of y; simulation mode is reported as not evaluable
models.test_features: variables computed on the concatenated series [estimation; test] with selection limited to estimation rows

ziran_ablations.change: no generated variables (readout on u(t), y(t) only)
registry without representation-change operators (discretize, sign, continuize)
registry without delay, window and temporal-diff operators

fairness_rule: if a Ziran / Xeno variant improves over the best conventional model on any pre-registered metric or regime, the corresponding conventional extensions (higher order ARX, PWARX with threshold, NARX with saturation, grey-box with overflow, twin/EKF) are compared on that same metric; if any extension matches, the distinction is reported as not uniquely required

questions.Q2_regimes: RMSE in the y ≥ 9.0 V and y < 9.0 V test bands
questions.Q3_observation_adequacy: pairs of estimation samples with |Δy(t)| ≤ 0.05 V and |Δu(t)| ≤ 0.05 V whose next-step output changes differ by more than 0.3 V; counted as an empirical observation; per model, a representation-insufficiency signal: residual autocorrelation at lag 1 above 2/√N on the estimation record (all models), aliasing records (Ziran adapter), normalized innovation test (twin)
questions.Q4_description_revision: whether any Ziran variant retains generated variables and whether they change held-out one-step RMSE
questions.Q5_timing: lag of maximal cross-correlation between Δu and Δy on the estimation record (descriptive empirical observation); too-late correction analysis is not applicable because the dataset contains no recorded corrections

counterfactual: one unvalidated counterfactual demonstration: test input scaled by 1.2, simulated with M1, M4b and M5; reported as model output only, never as an empirical finding
compute_reporting: fit time, inference time, trainable parameters, observations used, adaptation steps (optimizer evaluations / epochs); no equalization
exclusions: none planned; any post-hoc exclusion or model change is recorded as an exploratory follow-up without overwriting the pre-registered results
seeds: 1–5 wherever randomness is used (multi-starts, MLP initialization)
stopping: Nelder–Mead: 4000 evaluations or simplex size < 1e-9; MLP: fixed 500 epochs; morphogenesis: 3 rounds
missing_data_handling: not needed (no missing samples); the rule would have been: no imputation, samples excluded from metrics and reported
